Type Parameters:

All Superinterfaces:

All Known Subinterfaces:

public interface Slot<Self extends Slot<Self>> extends Inventory
A single slot in an inventory. Can only hold a single ItemStack

    • canSet

      @CheckReturnValue boolean canSet(@NotNull @NotNull ItemStack stack, Consumer<SlotSetOptions> options)
      Checks if the provided item can be set into the slot using the options provided. This does not actually set the item Note 1: This does not checks via event so if an event cancels the setting of the item then Slot.Mutable.set(ItemStack) returns false, but as this doesn't check events this may return true but set returns false Note 2: Itemstack cannot be null (despite it can be in Slot.Mutable.set(ItemStack)) this is due to clearing the slot should always be true (except when events cancel it)
      Parameters:
      stack - the itemstack to check against.
      options - the options to use
      Returns:
      true if it can set, false if cannot
